memories.text: I stand under the shop canopy on the main street. The pawn shop is nearby.
There is a warehouse district not far from the shops.
Dufus is the friendly fool who wanders the street. He is wearing his hat but keeps asking about it.
Dufus is still wandering the street and still asking about his hat.
Dufus is nearby again and still asking about his hat.
Dufus is nearby again and still asking about his hat; he is wearing it.
Dufus was nearby asking about his hat, but he was already wearing it.
